name: Hannah Dwyer
text: Grace has cleaned for us every second Thursday since March. I've never had to explain anything twice, and the price on the website was exactly what we paid.

name: Tomasz Nowak
text: Our property manager flagged the rangehood filter. They were back the next morning and fixed it. Full bond back.

name: Aroha Ngata
text: Four kids, two dogs, one very tired house. The deep clean got the grout and the fans that I'd stopped seeing. Worth every dollar.

name: Dev Patel
text: Reliable and careful with our things. They were 20 minutes late once but texted ahead, which I appreciated.

name: Jo Kim
text: Booked from my phone between inspections. They cleaned inside every cupboard before the removalists came.

name: Margaret O'Sullivan
text: I'm 81 and can't do the floors any more. Luis is lovely, always on time, and leaves the kitchen sparkling.

name: Ben Carter
text: Monthly clean for our townhouse. Easy to skip a visit when we're away, no fuss.

name: Leilani Fonoti
text: Clear price up front, no surprises. The agent's checklist and theirs matched line for line.
